climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A PGI in the Landes department, next to the Tursan appellation, where white grapes lead the plantings: Colombard 27%, Baco Blanc 18% and Gros Manseng 18%. It was called vin de pays des terroirs landais until 2009.
